final: WITH invoice_counts AS (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoices GROUP BY order_id), overall AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_count FROM invoice_counts), shares AS (SELECT CAST(invoice_count AS REAL) / total_count AS share FROM invoice_counts CROSS JOIN overall WHERE total_count IS NOT NULL), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares), kept AS (SELECT share FROM shares CROSS JOIN avg_share WHERE share > mean_share) SELECT (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) FROM invoice_counts WHERE CAST(invoice_count AS REAL) / (SELECT total_count FROM overall) > (SELECT mean_share FROM avg_share)) AS total_invoice_counts, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - mean_share) AS average_excess_share FROM kept CROSS JOIN avg_share
